_note: Deliberate exceptions to the 26.3-leakage audit. A finding listed here is reported as `accepted` instead of failing — but only when the port genuinely covers the missing name at every read site the tool flags. Each entry needs a reason and a code pointer; an exception without either is not an exception, it is a suppression. The 1.21.7 supports_* tags are excepted because they are now synthesized from 1.21.7 equivalents at BOTH read sites: worldgen (GeneratorData::load in worldgen/generator.rs) and runtime (level/data.rs build_with_gameplay), via worldgen/tags.rs synthesize_legacy_support_tags / LEGACY_SUPPORT_FLUID_TAGS — all mappings jar-verified against 1.21.7. Exception: supports_frogspawn has no block synthesis by design (vanilla is fluid-only); only its fluid tag is synthesized. Schema: version -> family (tags|attributes|gamerules) -> name -> reason.
